Package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog

Class BleDailyConnectionsHistoryLog

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.HistoryLog
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.BleDailyConnectionsHistoryLog
public class BleDailyConnectionsHistoryLog extends HistoryLog
Once-a-day Tandem Mobi summary of the BLE connections made to the pump. The pump writes it every 24 hours counted from its last restart, not at midnight, so its time of day differs between pumps and each record covers the 24 hours since the previous one. The header timestamp is the end of that period.

The counts were compared with the connections and JPAKE authentications TandemKit logged in 12 day-long windows on two pumps (the maintainer's and a tester's). getConnections() minus getUnauthenticatedConnections() equalled the number of authenticated sessions in all 12 windows. The class name is provisional: opcode 474 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi app's history log list. Fields not named here have not been identified and are exposed raw. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/152.

    • getConnectedPercent

      public int getConnectedPercent()
      The share of the 24 hours during which the pump had a BLE connection, apparently rounded to the nearest percent. Values of 97-100 were observed. It matched the phone-side connected time in 11 of 12 windows; the twelfth was 0.02 points below the rounding threshold. It read 100 with getConnections() 0 on a day with no reconnection. Medium confidence.
      Returns:
      percent of the period with a BLE connection, 0-100

    • getUnknown11

      public int getUnknown11()
      Constant per pump: 6 on both of the maintainer's Mobis, 4 on a tester's. Its meaning is unknown, and it is not a firmware or model code.
      Returns:
      raw uint8 at offset 11

    • getConnections

      public int getConnections()
      BLE connections the pump accepted during the period, including ones that failed encryption or never authenticated. Values of 0-66 were observed. This equalled the connections the phone logged (connects plus encryption failures) in 8 of 12 windows. In the other 4 it was exactly 2 higher, from connections the phone never reported. Byte 13 was 0 in every record, so it is read as a uint16; byte 12 alone gives the same values.
      Returns:
      number of BLE connections in the period

    • getUnauthenticatedConnections

      public int getUnauthenticatedConnections()
      Connections during the period that never completed JPAKE authentication (key confirmation), including failed encryption and links dropped during setup. Values of 0-11 were observed. The value was 0 exactly on the days the phone logged no failed, cancelled or timed-out connection. Byte 15 was always 0, so it is read as a uint16, like getConnections().
      Returns:
      number of connections that did not authenticate

    • getAuthenticatedConnections

      public int getAuthenticatedConnections()
      Equal to the authenticated sessions TandemKit logged in 12 of 12 windows on two pumps.
      Returns:
      getConnections() minus getUnauthenticatedConnections()

    • getUnknownTail

      public byte[] getUnknownTail()
      Bytes 16-25. Zero in every record examined. No new pairing happened in any window examined, so a pairing counter here would also have read 0.
      Returns:
      a copy of bytes 16-25
